about.title: About Pomodoro Technique - Chronos Pomodoro
about.heading: The Pomodoro Technique 🍅
about.p1: The Pomodoro Technique is a productivity methodology created by Francesco Cirillo, which consists of dividing work into time blocks (the famous "Pomodoros") interspersed with breaks. The goal is to maintain total focus for a short period and ensure rest to avoid mental fatigue.
about.howItWorks: How does the traditional Pomodoro work?
about.step1: 1. Define a task you want to accomplish.
about.step2: 2. Work on it for 25 minutes without interruptions.
about.step3: 3. Take a short break of 5 minutes.
about.step4: 4. Every 4 cycles, take a long break (usually 15 to 30 minutes).
about.differentialP: Our app follows the original concept, but with some improvements and customizations to make the process even more efficient:
about.customTimeP: You can configure focus time, short break and long break however you want! Just access the <link>settings page</link> and adjust the minutes as you prefer.
about.cyclesP: Each completed cycle automatically adds a new task to your history, and the app already suggests the next cycle (focus or break).
about.cycle8: Cycle 8: Special long break to reset the full cycle.
about.visualizationP: Right below the timer, you will see colored dots representing the cycles:
about.visualizationP2: So you always know where you are in the process and what comes next. No more paper notes or mental calculations!
about.historyAutoP: All your completed tasks and cycles are saved in the <link>history</link>, with completed or interrupted status. This way you can track your evolution over time.
about.why2: ✅ Work and rest in the right measure.
about.why3: ✅ Customize your own cycles and times.
about.ready: Ready to focus? Let's go back to the home page and start your Pomodoros! 🍅🚀
about.quote: "Total focus, no rush, no pause, just go!" 💪🧘‍♂️
